name: s4-permission-popup
note: Camera first run: the location-tag prompt ('다음'), then the location permission dialog. CAMERA and RECORD_AUDIO are granted by default on this image, so location is the popup. pm clear alone keeps the user-set location grant, hence the revokes; setup runs them through host adb (`mobax shell` is a REPL, MCP has no device shell). Bare-word targets read as class names, hence :has-text.
